capabilities: : Integrate data into Daily Notes frontmatter
extras: Desktop only. Requires an author-hosted Cloudflare Worker for OAuth.
intentEvidence: Sync your Withings scale measurements into Obsidian Daily Notes — automatically, in the background
problem: Manually recording health metrics from a scale into daily notes is time-consuming and prone to error.

relations.evidence: This plugin calls the Withings cloud API (wbsapi.withings.net) to read your scale measurements after you connect your account.

summary: Sync Withings scale measurements into Obsidian Daily Notes frontmatter automatically, allowing tracking of weight and body composition.
